title: H 5081 (125th General Assembly): Constitutional amendment

(e_other_rule)
(section) Sec. 1 (Const. Art. II, Sec. 4)
(quote) Only a citizen of the United States and of this State of the age of eighteen and upwards who is properly registered is entitled to vote as provided by law.
(section) Sec. 2 (ballot question)
(quote) Must Section 4, Article II of the Constitution of this State, relating to voter qualifications, be amended so as to clarify that only a citizen of the United States and of this State of the age of eighteen and upwards who is properly registered is entitled to vote as provided by law?
(other) Sec. 2: amendment goes to voters at the next general election for representatives, with the ballot wording quoted above.
(other) version: Only one version (Introduced, 2024-02-13). Joint resolution proposing a constitutional amendment; no ID or citizenship-proof text in slots a-d. The only change is 'Every' struck and 'Only a' added before 'citizen'.
(other) note: Citizens-only constitutional amendment (resolution, not a bill). Strike/new marker for 'Every'/'Only a' read from the HTML styling. Only the introduced text is saved.
(note) Off this topic: the bill sets no ID or citizenship-proof rule.
